elements.label: Tick ruler with event marker ticks

pattern.description: A horizontal timeline (faint tick ruler, bold marker ticks, a text label above each marker) scrolls right-to-left at a near-constant rate; labels ('and every', 'User record', 'Stripe payment') enter from the right edge and exit off the left edge.
pattern.why_premium: Constant-velocity scroll reads as time passing and lets the narration name each data source as its label crosses centre; minimal monochrome type on a ruler keeps it calm and editorial instead of a busy UI demo.

build_hint.gsap: Put labels and ticks in one track element inside an overflow-hidden full-width container; gsap.to(track, {x: '-=<distance>', duration: 1.9, ease: 'none'}) chained across events (or one long linear tween), labels positioned absolutely at their marker ticks.
build_hint.remotion: translateX = interpolate(frame, [start, end], [0, -distance], {extrapolateRight: 'extend'}) on the track (linear, no spring); labels and marker ticks are children of the track; container overflow: hidden.

notes: Camera verdict is none; pan_x reflects the content scroll, not a camera move. The scroll is full-frame width, so the 'mask' is the frame edge rather than a card; 'other' (timeline ruler scroll) would also be defensible. Spectrogram shows a regular tick-like pulse in the music bed but no SFX candidates were provided.
